purpose: Documentation-only close-basis and trade-state investigation; not market-data acquisition or source qualification.

questions.question: For the F&O UDiFF final bhavcopy applicable on 2026-09-10, what rule populates ClsPric versus daily high/low for nonzero-volume futures, including illiquid or missing qualifying-trade cases?
questions.required_answer: Authoritative field mapping, eligible price/trade universe, fallback conditions and effective dates; a general settlement methodology alone is insufficient.

questions.question: Which original, modified, cancelled, rejected, custodian-confirmed or special trades contribute to total quantity and to each OHLC field, and is this attribution recoverable from the aggregate bhavcopy?
questions.required_answer: Official contribution matrix and aggregate-file limitations; status-code definitions alone do not resolve inclusion.

questions.question: Does any documented rule actually establish an explanation for the two retained close-range observations without inferring a trade state or manufacturing values?
questions.required_answer: Separate general rule applicability from case-specific proof. If aggregate evidence cannot establish case applicability, record unresolved and remain unqualified.

source_selection_rule: Five fixed official NSE-published documentation URLs from sealed R10N-G inventory only. A revised link, additional circular, SEBI document or written NSE clarification requires an explicit scope amendment before access. No contact or message is proposed as automatically authorized.
closeout: Record answered/unanswered questions and evidence limitations. No retry, bypass, crawl, adapter change, row attribution, waiver, price mutation, qualification, ingestion or activation. Implementation and all-date requalification require later separate authorization.
